To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) The surface roughness of the substrate does not have an effect on the coherence times of NV centers, (2) The coherence times of NVs are not influenced by the surface termination (H- or O-termination) of the substrate, (3) The coherence time of the NV center can be increased by oxygen treatment at 520 \degC for all samples and (4) The coherence times are not correlated with the implantation energy of the NV center.
